subject: Re: Public session details
text: As a follow-up to our earlier thread, the change in priorities means we are replacing the full workshop with a brief public update. It will be held in the main hall on Friday morning from ten to ten forty-five, with doors opening fifteen minutes early. The emphasis will be on revised timelines and immediate next steps rather than the planned hands-on session. Only two presenters are required, and printed handouts will not be distributed this week. Please confirm if you can attend briefly or provide a short summary for recording, as the materials will be posted afterward.
